idempotency.durable: runtime store property; must inspect actual response
idempotency.ordinary_scope: SHA256(active profile + NUL + expected API credential); raw credential is never persisted
idempotency.fingerprint: SHA256(canonical JSON of exact parsed body and gateway_session_key)
idempotency.conflict: same scope/key with different fingerprint is rejected
idempotency.replay: existing receipt lookup precedes concurrency admission

continuation.source_behavior: POST /v1/runs selects body.session_id, then previous_response_id session, then declared X-Hermes-Session-Key session, else fresh run_id. It loads selected session history only when conversation_history is empty and previous_response_id is absent. Compression may resolve the supplied session ID to its live successor.

native_attempt_adapter.reason: The generic gateway plugin registration context does not authenticate Orbit attempt authority. The shipped adapter starts a dedicated pinned local Hermes process with a private profile and exact approved session ID; channel scope is supplied out of band.
native_attempt_adapter.plugin_api: register(ctx); ctx.get_config(key, default); ctx.register_tool(name, toolset, schema, handler)
native_attempt_adapter.private_tools_endpoint: POST /tool over mode-0600 Unix socket inside mode-0700 directory; HMAC-SHA256(sequence + newline + exact body), private per-attempt key, monotonically increasing sequence
native_attempt_adapter.runtime_retention: Up to 128 entries in the dedicated private runtime directory; exact channel-key file is removed after process exit, generated Hermes homes are retained with private retention receipts rather than recursively deleted by a request.
native_attempt_adapter.continuation_limit: The private attempt-local Hermes database starts fresh. Matching the approved profile/session identity does not import or continue the original gateway's tool history.
native_attempt_adapter.tested: actual pinned Hermes + actual plugin + deterministic local OpenAI HTTP/SSE fixture; no paid inference
